acceptanceCriteria: The flaking test is named from a reproduced loaded run.
The test passes 20 consecutive runs under saturating load.
The test uses an injected clock or non-wall-clock budget, or a bound justified against load.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, 2026-10-04, origin/main 8a3e3a5b. A liveverify budget test flakes under host load. Suspected, not confirmed: sensitivity to a wall-clock budget. The exact test name was not retained; locate it with go test -count=1 ./internal/liveverify/... under saturating load. Related: V1-0036, V1-0636, V1-0455. Expected: the budget check is deterministic under load (injected clock or generous bound with the assertion preserved). Actual: intermittent failure under load, passing alone.
title: liveverify budget test flakes under host load
